title: Design System: Physlib City C1 and C2

components.name: Source geography breadcrumb
components.description: Compact warm-paper navigation retaining source geography labels.

narrative.overview: The opt-in visual=c1 scene foregrounds broad original Three.js architecture. Experience governs the scene; Operate governs source tools. Milestone C remains the default pending approval and resolution of the reported software-rendered performance regression. The opt-in visual=c2 extension adds persistent source-address colour grammar and reversible Explore drawers; source data remains unchanged and default promotion remains pending. The ordinary opt-in visual=c3 candidate adds broad space-age module silhouettes and expanded non-module civic forecourts while preserving C2 anchors, plots, heightmap, registry and graph; default C and comparison C2 remain unchanged. Independent review still finds partial metropolis/campus grouping and approval remains pending.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory masses and coloured roofs
Canonical source semantics independent of decoration
Version-1 registry: 39 directory and 3 Root Modules territories
Four district composition motifs and four civic landmark silhouettes
Civic scenery is not graph data
C3 candidate: broad silhouettes, dark glazing, rounded porticos and non-module civic forecourts

rules.name: Persistent silhouette
rules.body: Broad masses remain visible at every detail tier; close detail does not define the silhouette.

rules.name: Geographic address
rules.body: C2 directory colour and stable civic patterns identify source geography, never proof status, completion or scientific rank. Exact assignments remain owned by site/city-colors.js.

dos: Preserve exact module identities and source floors.
Keep C1 and default C available alongside opt-in C2.
Keep C3 opt-in; retain default C and comparison C2 unchanged.
donts: Do not equate decorative storeys with declarations.
Do not treat civic landmarks, streets, bridges or trees as modules or import endpoints.
